controls.name: TopBar
controls.purpose: The site header: back button and page title on the left at every width, the search centred; on a phone the title takes the row and the search collapses to an icon button that expands to a full-width field.
controls.mobile: Below 640px the search is a 44px icon button; tapping it turns the bar into a field, Escape or the close button puts it back.

controls.name: AppShell
controls.purpose: The application frame: a sidebar, a main column with the top bar, the page body and a footer strip. Its structure classes (page, sidebar, content, page-body) belong to the host app; the SDK owns the top bar it contains.
controls.mobile: At 1024px and below the sidebar goes off-canvas behind the hamburger in the top bar.
